decks.notes: The deck focuses on using Greasefang and Parhelion II as key combo pieces to generate value and create a powerful board state. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with cards using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Grisly Salvage, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command. It also includes cards like Raffine's Informant and Satyr Wayfinder to help dig for combo pieces. The deck utilizes various lands to support its mana base and ensure it can consistently cast its spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up your mana using cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, then use that mana to cast powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Storm the Festival helps you find those key creatures, while cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx provide additional mana sources. Teferi, Kiora, and Karn offer additional support and utility. The strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with strong creatures and efficient mana usage, aiming for a quick victory.

This deck focuses on applying early pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It uses aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to chip away at the opponent's life total, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. The deck also has card advantage engines like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Liliana of the Veil to ensure a steady stream of threats. The key idea is to maintain a fast pace of play, forcing the opponent to react to your threats while you control the battlefield.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant, supported by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck aims to pressure opponents quickly and efficiently, utilizing a mix of powerful threats and removal options to control the board and close out games before the opponent can stabilize. With a strong mana base and a mix of hand disruption and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and utilizing devotion to green to play powerful green cards. The deck utilizes mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to ramp, along with cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The deck also includes powerful green devotion cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns to pressure the opponent. Additionally, cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help provide card advantage and additional threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures and efficient mana ramp.

The main focus of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to consistently apply pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. With strong early game threats like Knight of the Ebon Legion and Bloodsoaked Champion, backed up by powerful beaters like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Liliana of the Veil, this deck aims to control the board and chip away at the opponent's life total quickly. The deck also utilizes utility lands like Mutavault and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to provide additional synergy and options in combat.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while using powerful creatures like Kroxa and Bonecrusher Giant to apply pressure. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption and card advantage, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Graveyard Trespasser help to maintain the deck's aggressive tempo. The deck aims to close out games quickly by efficiently removing threats and dealing damage to the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays that aim to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. It includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to clear the way for powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Tenacious Underdog and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional pressure. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive nature, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and cast powerful green creatures and planeswalkers. By playing various mana dorks and enchantments, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana to cast high-cost cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. It also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator for additional value. Additionally, the deck includes a few non-green cards like Vraska, Golgari Queen and Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God for added versatility and power.

The main concept of the deck is to ramp up quickly with mana-producing creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then use that mana to play powerful green cards with high devotion like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. This deck aims to aggressively control the board through a combination of discard spells, removal, and efficient threats. This deck focuses on quickly getting multiple spirit creatures onto the battlefield and using them to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of evasion, tempo plays, and disruptive abilities. The deck contains a mix of aggressive creatures, support creatures, and disruptive spells to keep the opponent on the back foot while steadily chipping away at their life total. By efficiently deploying threats and protecting them with counter spells, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize and mount a defense.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and generating card advantage through card draw. The deck also aims to create a win condition through Shark Typhoon tokens or planeswalker ultimates. The mana base is designed to consistently hit the necessary colors for spells while including utility lands for additional value.
